text:
maria: Heads-up — planning to start the v2 rollout slowstart at 02:00 UTC tomorrow. Can we confirm client pin windows and finalize the tiny release-note blurb?

sam: ack. what's the slowstart schedule? 5% -> 25% -> 75% over how long?

maria: thinking: 5% for 15m, 25% for 30m, 75% for 30m then monitor and full at operator ok. slowstart to protect mobile clients.

kai: vote to keep the mobile route pinned to v1 for 6h post-full rollout. we've seen flaky RPC header drops on some old SDKs.

olivia: +1 on 6h mobile pin. also suggest a short note for release notes: one-line: "v2 API: improved response stability and header normalization; mobile clients may remain on v1 briefly" — we should include migration tips link.

devrel: i can add a short migration snippet. propose:```
If your app uses the mobile SDK v0.9 or earlier, please pin to v1 for 6 hours after the rollout and upgrade to SDK v1.2. See: https://redwood.dev/migrate-v2
```

sam: deploy-bot, show scheduled job?

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout initiated by maria — id: roll-1729009876. plan: slowstart(5%/25%/75%), start: 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z, operator-handoff: 2026-03-22T04:00:00Z. auto-rollback triggers: >3% 5xx rate OR >15% latency regression over baseline for 10m.

maria: noted. two operational asks: 1) telemetry team — please pre-create the v1/v2 comparison dash (latency, 5xx, client pins). 2) ops — be ready to flip mobile-pin flag if we see header errors.

kai: ops on standby. i'll add a quick playbook snippet in the runbook and push a gate to the deploy bot with pinned-mobile route.

olivia: about release notes — shorten the blurb to match marketing tone. draft: "v2 rollout: header normalization and performance improvements. Mobile SDK users on v0.9 or earlier should pin to v1 during the 6h handback window; upgrade recommended." ok?

devrel: looks good. i'll sync to the release-notes doc and add the migration link.

sam: one more ask — are we enabling the v2 compatibility shim for legacy clients? if not, we should keep a fallback route.

maria: yes, compatibility shim remains for 48h. fallback will route to v1 when client-version header absent or fails negotiation. that's in the rollout config.

deploy-bot: note — added gate: mobile_pin=true by default for first 6h; ops can set mobile_pin=false to release earlier. fallback-policy=shim-48h.

kai: i'll be watching logs for header errors and will post any anomalies here.

maria: thanks all. final checklist: release-note blurb merged (devrel), dash prepped (telemetry), ops standby (kai), deploy scheduled (deploy-bot). I'll post a handback when we hit the operator window. :rocket:
